entities.summary: Janne Juvonen is a Finnish professional ice hockey goaltender who plays for Kölner Haie of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Juvonen was selected by the Nashville Predators in the 7th round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
